understanding the relocation risks of intra‐firm decision‐makers.

the relocation risk perceptions are complex and multifaceted.
the risks related to relocation can be categorized into five categories.
relocation risk is a complex phenomenon.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
relocation risk is not a simple phenomenon, but one that should be considered in a holistic manner.
the relocation process is not only about the financial and functional issues but also about people, their perceptions and emotions.
relocation risks can be divided into categories that have been identified in the literature, but that the empirical material also adds to our understanding of these categories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
relocation is not a simple process and it should be considered as such.
the relocation process should be considered as a risk‐taking process.
relocation risks can be categorized and that this categorization can be used to reduce the risks.
